review.notes: This is the same organization OUSD contracts with. Close Up Foundation is the national nonprofit that runs student civic-education trips to Washington, D.C., and that fits the Life Academy student travel item. Its site also shows California seller-of-travel registration CST-1002082-40. The cited sources confirm every field: GuideStar and the FAQ page give EIN 23-7122882, a 1971 start, and nonprofit, nonpartisan status, and the site shows the Arlington, VA address, the 703-706-3300 phone number and the info@closeup.org general inbox. The summary is neutral.
